## What's new

**Check for a Personal Guard invite without a code.** Right-click the person who invited you → **Check Personal Guard invite**. If they made an invite for you in the last 10 minutes, you see it right away and can accept it.

The first time, you verify your account once on Discord's own login page. This proves to the Friends in Voice server that the account is really yours, so nobody can pretend to be you and take an invite meant for you. Friends in Voice only asks Discord for your user ID, and it never sees or keeps your password or token.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.22.0.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
